_comment: WHICH MODEL THE PREVIZ DRAWS FOR WHICH FIXTURE PROFILE. Previz only: nothing
in the show reads this, and a mistake here is a warning in the previz, never
an error that stops the engine.
Keyed "Manufacturer/Model" exactly as the .qxf declares them. 'file' is a
binary glTF (.glb), relative to this folder, then shared/models/. A rig.json
fixture's own `body` overrides its profile's entry here.
A moving head's model must follow the body convention in docs/models.md --
nodes base > yoke > head > lens, pan about +Y, tilt about +X, the beam out of
the lens along +Z -- or name its own nodes under 'nodes'. A profile with no
entry is drawn as a box sized from the .qxf's <Dimensions>.
